skill.name: agentdb-vector-search
skill.description: Implement AgentDB vector search for semantic retrieval, similarity matching, RAG workflows, and Claude Code MCP usage.
skill.summary: Build AgentDB semantic search workflows with CLI, TypeScript, RAG, and MCP examples.
skill.author: ruvnet

security_audit.summary: The skill is documentation for AgentDB vector search and contains no prompt injection or hidden execution logic. The real risks are user-initiated npx commands, especially the Claude Code MCP registration, while most static hits are Markdown fences, TypeScript examples, sample database paths, or reference links.

remediation.issue: Unpinned npx commands use agentdb@latest throughout the examples.
remediation.suggestion: Pin AgentDB to a reviewed version and require explicit approval before running npm-sourced commands.

remediation.issue: The MCP setup registers a Claude Code server command backed by npx.
remediation.suggestion: Document the persistence, removal steps, and trust requirements before adding the MCP server.

remediation.issue: Import and export examples can operate on vector databases that may contain private text.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users to test with non-sensitive data and review exported files before sharing them.

content.value_statement: Teams need fast semantic retrieval for documents and knowledge bases. This skill shows AgentDB setup, querying, RAG patterns, and MCP integration.
actual_capabilities: Shows CLI commands for AgentDB initialization, querying, import, export, and statistics.
Demonstrates TypeScript adapter setup with embeddings, metadata, and retrieval options.
Covers vector search, hybrid search, batch storage, and RAG query patterns.
Explains quantization choices, distance metrics, HNSW indexing, and caching concepts.
Includes MCP server setup notes for Claude Code workflows.
Provides troubleshooting checks for search speed, memory use, relevance, and vector dimensions.
limitations: The skill is documentation only and does not include runnable project files.
Examples depend on AgentDB, agentic-flow APIs, Node.js, and optional embedding providers.
OpenAI embedding use requires an API key that the skill does not manage.
Performance claims are presented as documentation and are not verified by included tests.

use_cases.title: Prototype document retrieval
use_cases.description: Create a local AgentDB vector store and test similarity search before building a larger application.

use_cases.title: Design a RAG workflow
use_cases.description: Map document embeddings, context retrieval, and answer generation into a repeatable RAG pattern.

use_cases.title: Connect Claude Code to AgentDB
use_cases.description: Review the MCP server commands needed to expose AgentDB query and storage tools.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Vector Database
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a local semantic search test.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the AgentDB vector search skill to outline the safest steps for creating a local test database with 1536 dimensions.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Search Options
prompt_templates.scenario: Choose settings for a retrieval feature.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the AgentDB vector search skill to compare cosine, euclidean, and dot-product search for my document retrieval use case.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a RAG Pipeline
prompt_templates.scenario: Build retrieval and answer generation around stored documents.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the AgentDB vector search skill to design a RAG workflow with metadata filters, top-k retrieval, and context synthesis.

prompt_templates.title: Review MCP Integration
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced integration with Claude Code tools.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the AgentDB vector search skill to audit an AgentDB MCP setup plan, including command approval, package pinning, and rollback steps.

output_examples.input: I need a local semantic search proof of concept for product documents.
output_examples.output: A setup plan with database dimensions, sample ingestion steps, similarity query settings, and validation checks for result quality.

output_examples.input: I want a RAG design that avoids duplicate context passages.
output_examples.output: A retrieval design using top-k search, relevance thresholds, metadata filters, and MMR for more diverse context.

output_examples.input: I need to connect AgentDB to Claude Code through MCP.
output_examples.output: A review checklist covering MCP command purpose, user approval, package version pinning, and test queries after registration.

best_practices: Pin package versions before running AgentDB commands in shared or automated environments.
Use test databases before importing, exporting, or querying production embeddings.
Choose vector dimensions that match the embedding model used to create the data.
anti_patterns: Do not run latest-tag npm commands automatically without user approval.
Do not mix embeddings from models with different dimensions in one index.
Do not export vector databases that may contain private document text without review.

faq.question: Does this skill install AgentDB automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides commands and examples that a user or agent may choose to run.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it include a full RAG application?
faq.answer: No. It shows patterns and snippets for building retrieval and generation workflows.

faq.question: Can it work without OpenAI embeddings?
faq.answer: Yes, the skill mentions custom embedding models and dimensions such as 768 and 384.

faq.question: Is the MCP setup permanent?
faq.answer: The Claude Code MCP command can register a server entry, so users should review and manage it deliberately.

faq.question: Are the benchmark claims independently tested here?
faq.answer: No. The skill documents benchmark claims but does not include test results or reproducible benchmark files.
